reference.author: Bernard Lee
reference.source_note: Commons exposes the 4:3 image dimensions and 26 mm 35mm-equivalent EXIF; exact photographer GPS is not published and is not asserted.

rejected_camera.reason: The source-backed frontage pair tested in PR #132 lies between this provisional camera and the Bourse and occludes the hero, proving the old pose is not defensible once true context is rendered.

candidate_policy.derivation: Use the official north-south hero bbox span as a conservative frontage-width bound and choose the west-side standoff whose angular width is 95% of the lawful reference's registered 69.4 degree horizontal FOV. Center Z on the same official bbox. Pitch centers the official 0..40.1553 m vertical extent around a 1.68 m eye height.

approval_note: This is a reproducible camera benchmark, not recovered photographer GPS. Accept only after deterministic capture inspection; do not move official geometry to satisfy the camera.
